title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

 

ABOUT US

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

 

 

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

 

YOUR IMPACT

We are a leading SaaS company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that empower businesses to streamline operations and drive growth. As we continue to expand our footprint in the enterprise sector, we are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to join our sales team.

The Enterprise Account Executive will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities with large enterprise clients. This role requires a consultative sales approach, deep understanding of enterprise needs, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles to deliver tailored SaaS solutions.

  • New Business Development: Identify and prospect potential enterprise clients, targeting key decision-makers in relevant industries. Develop strategies to generate new business opportunities and build a robust sales pipeline.
  • Consultative Selling: Utilize a consultative approach to understand client needs and pain points. Provide tailored solutions that demonstrate the value of our SaaS platform, aligning with the customer’s business objectives.
  • Sales Cycle Management: Manage the entire sales process from lead generation to closing, including qualification, solution presentation, negotiation, and contract signing. Collaborate with internal teams to support client needs throughout the sales cycle.

  • Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders at enterprise accounts, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and engagement.
  • Account Strategy: Collaborate with internal teams to develop and execute account strategies that lead to long-term partnerships and continued revenue growth. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Revenue Target Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas, focusing on closing large, high-value deals.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate and up-to-date pipeline of opportunities in the CRM. Provide regular sales forecasts and reports to senior management.
  • Market Insights: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and market dynamics. Share insights with the product and marketing teams to help shape the company’s go-to-market strategy and product roadmap.
  • Sales Process Improvement: Continuously refine sales processes, strategies, and tools to optimize efficiency and success in enterprise sales

 

YOUR EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years of experience in enterprise sales.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing large enterprise deals, ideally in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS sales processes, including value-based selling and account-based strategies.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives and other decision-makers.
  • Experience managing long and complex sales cycles, with a focus on building strong client relationships.
  • Proficiency with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Strong business acumen, problem-solving abilities, and strategic thinking

description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners. AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA Responsibilities: Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify. Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk. Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices. Write high-quality, well-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in. Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand. Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well. Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human-written and AI-generated code alike. Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non-production environments without approved controls. Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval. Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on-call rotation for platform emergencies. Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system-generated evidence replace ceremony-driven tracking. Qualifications Hands-on experience with spec-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval.
